title: Salve regina I (Munich 34) (Vinders)
desc: Jheronimus Vinders, Salve regina I (Munich 34). 6 voices (Superius I, Superius II, Altus, Tenor I, Tenor II, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: Munich 34. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From The 1520s Project (1520s-project.org, Vin2001); encoded by Benjamin Ory. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
